evals.fixture: .dev/rate-limit-api/plan.md with Goal, Success criteria, Scope already filled in, in a repo whose package.json defines a `test` script (jest) and a `typecheck` script
assertions: At least one task_N.md is written, numbered starting at 1
Each task has Goal, Scope (In/Out), Acceptance criteria, Test plan, Self-validation loop, and Depends on sections
Acceptance criteria per task number 2-5, describe behavior (not "implementation done"), and each line is tagged with its test layer ([unit], [integration], or [e2e])

The Test plan maps each acceptance criterion to a concrete test naming the seam/scenario and any fixtures or setup needed - it does not restate the criterion and does not repeat the layer already carried by the criterion's tag

The Self-validation loop uses the repo's real commands taken from package.json (npm test / npm run typecheck), not a guessed default from a different ecosystem, with a clear green exit condition and a fix-and-repeat instruction

Tasks are written to be executed by a junior engineer in parallel with peers: independent where possible, with shared-file contention sequenced via Depends on, and each Depends on entry tagged with its reason (interface or files)
The layer definitions the criteria rely on are self-contained in the task (inlined), not left as a link that would 404 from the task file's location
Every In item of the plan's Scope is claimed by at least one task; no scope item is silently dropped
No catch-all task (titled cleanup, remaining items, misc, or similar)
The plan's Execution section is updated with a task index table carrying Depends on and Status columns
The plan's HTML view is not re-rendered or republished by this skill - that remains to-plan's responsibility
